title: Consolidated Questionnaire Fastpath and Tiered Credit Pilot
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Summary:
A pilot to reduce friction for enterprise customers completing security questionnaires (CAIQ/CIS-style and ad-hoc questionnaires) by providing a consolidated "fastpath": modular answer bundles, automated attestation metadata, and a tiered pricing-credit gating mechanism. The goal is to accelerate deal cycles for mid-market and growth customers while limiting manual Legal/Security lift for high-risk RFPs.

Goals (measurable):
- Reduce average time-to-complete security questionnaire for pilot cohort by 40% vs. baseline (currently ~18 business days).
- Decrease manual evidence requests per RFP by 50% for pilot customers.
- Keep annualized revenue impact of credits < 1% for participants during pilot.
- Surface audit-ready attestation artifacts in Console and Contract attachments.

Scope:
- Build a modular answer library (packets) mapped to common questionnaire frameworks (CAIQ, SOC-adjacent items) and to our product feature set.
- Implement a fastpath UI/flow in the Console where customers can select prefilled packets and optionally add custom answers.
- Attach a machine-readable attestation file (JSON) that records who accepted the answers, timestamp, and hash for audit purposes.
- Create a pricing-credit gating rule: small tier credit (e.g., one-time onboarding credit) if customer uses X or more validated packets and accepts attestation; larger credits require additional verification (manual review by Security).
- Add metrics to the Console and Sales dashboard: questionnaire completion time, manual follow-ups avoided, credit utilization, and deal close delta.

Out of scope for pilot:
- Full automation of vendor-specific bespoke questionnaires (we will still accept uploads).
- Changes to enterprise contract language; Legal will provide recommended clauses but not modify standard contracts during pilot.

Acceptance criteria:
- End-to-end flow (select packets -> accept attestation -> credit assigned) works for at least three internal test customers (Sales QA).
- Audit artifact (attestation JSON) appears in customer Console and is downloadable from contract page.
- Dashboard shows baseline and live pilot metrics; product analytics validate the 40% completion reduction target for pilot cohort.
- Pricing team approves credit rates and expected ROI analysis documented in PRD.

Technical notes / Implementation approach:
- Backend: build an "answer-packets" service (CRUD) and a signing service that issues attestation JSON (signed with KMS key reference). Attestation fields: packet_ids[], accepted_by, accepted_at, product_versions[], attest_hash.
- Console: Add a "Questionnaire fastpath" flow; reuse existing Contract attachments UI.
- Billing: small one-off credit issuance API (billing-credit.create) gated by attestation validation.
- Security: integrate attestation signing with existing HSM/KMS workflows; ensure audit logs go to centralized logging and retention policy matches enterprise requirements.
- Data model: minimal and append-only (no deletion of issued attestations).

Trade-offs and risks:
- Over-crediting: risk of giving credits to customers who accept but later request more evidence; mitigation: tiered credits and manual verify for high-risk or high-ARR accounts.
- Product-surface accuracy: prefilled answers may be incorrect for customers with custom deployments; mitigation: clear disclaimers and an easy override path that flags Legal/Security review.
- Operational load: initial manual review queue may spike; mitigate by limiting pilot to a curated cohort (mid-market, ARR < $250k).

Metrics / Success signals (first 8 weeks):
- Pilot adoption rate: >= 30% of invited accounts use at least one packet.
- Median time-to-complete drops by >= 40% for adopters.
- Manual follow-ups per RFP drops by 50% for adopters.
- Net revenue impact of credits remains < 1% of ARR for pilot group.

Rollout plan / timeline:
- Week 0-2: Design & Security review (Confluence PRD link below).
- Week 3-5: Backend spike + KMS attestation prototype.
- Week 6-7: Console fastpath UI and billing integration.
- Week 8: Internal QA with Sales test customers.
- Week 9-12: Limited pilot (30 customers), collect metrics and qualitative feedback.
- Week 13: Decide: expand, iterate, or sunset.
